label: Delivery delay
mitigation: Delay in start-up (DSU) insurance moves the storm-caused part of this to the insurer.

label: Cost overruns
mitigation: A guaranteed maximum price (GMP) contract moves overruns to the general contractor.

label: Storm delay
mitigation: DSU moves storm delay cost to the insurer while it is active.

label: Power plant slip
mitigation: A higher minimum power charge lowers slip odds and shifts more of this to the utility.

label: Stranded plant capacity
mitigation: Informational. See the codex; ratepayers carry this cost in the real world.

label: Refinancing risk
mitigation: Lower leverage at close reduces the odds of a failed conversion test.

label: Tenant exit
mitigation: Cut from v1 as a mechanic (residual value guarantee); informational only.

label: Interest rate movement
mitigation: No in-game mitigation. Rate moves are market events.

label: Labor shortage
mitigation: A project labor agreement or importing crews reduces or prevents this.

label: Water availability gap
mitigation: Hybrid or dry cooling keeps more of this with the town instead of you.

label: Chip generation obsolescence
mitigation: Hybrid tier keeps this with the tenant; air tier shifts some of it to you.
